title: Cardio + light strength · 28 September
label: 40-MINUTE MIX · ELBOW-FRIENDLY
coachNote: Recovery-biased session after yesterday's elliptical + 35-floor stair climb. Right elbow is improved but not 100%, so no heavy pressing, pulling, hanging, or gripping. Start with 20 min elliptical at RPE 5–6, then 2 light strength rounds, calf PT, and a cautious PT-style wrist-curl trial. Stop any upper-body movement that reproduces or increases right-elbow pain. Finish with 5 min easy elliptical if time allows.

exercises.name: CARDIO — Elliptical
exercises.target: 20 minutes total · 5 min easy + 15 min RPE 5–6
exercises.note: Steady aerobic work, no intervals. Enter resistance/level in weight if useful, and reps=1 to mark complete.

exercises.name: A1 · LIGHT CIRCUIT — Goblet squat
exercises.target: 2 × 10 @ 24 kg if elbow is comfortable holding it
exercises.note: If gripping the weight bothers the right elbow, reduce load or skip.

exercises.name: A2 · LIGHT CIRCUIT — Two-hand kettlebell swing
exercises.note: Hip-driven Russian-style swing to about chest height. Arms guide the bell; do not turn it into a front raise. Choose a conservative swing load and stop if gripping bothers the elbow.

exercises.name: PT · Single-leg standing calf raise
exercises.note: PT priority. Full rise, brief top hold, ~3-second lowering. Last session was pain-free.

exercises.name: PT TRIAL · Palms-up dumbbell wrist curl
exercises.target: Start 1 × 10–12 each arm; up to 2–3 sets only if comfortable
exercises.note: Forearm fully supported, palm up, wrist/hand just beyond bench edge. Start very light (~2–3 kg). If this matches what PT demonstrated, allow a gentle finger roll then close fingers and curl wrist up. Stop if right-elbow pain is reproduced or increases. Confirm exact version/load/reps with PT next visit.

exercises.name: OPTIONAL — Easy elliptical cooldown
exercises.note: Recovery pace only. Enter reps=1 to mark complete.
